content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a collision between the challenger's and defender's chain readings of Matthew 1:20, which is the kind of chain-against-chain collision K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse': one reading requires the judge to compare the competing chains' footings before declaring underdetermined; the other allows a bare notation that each side answered as sufficient. I adopt the first.","why":"The judge text leaves the collision underdetermined merely because each side has an answer, without weighing the chains by footing as K-C requires."}
